info.name: BLUE V1 - Booking
info.description:
BLUE V1 Phase 7A Booking read endpoints, generated from the actual implementation in backend/routes/api.php, backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Booking, backend/app/Actions/Booking, and verified against backend/tests/Feature/Booking. See docs/api-contracts/bookings-v1.md for the full written contract.

A Booking is never created through any endpoint in this collection - it is created automatically, server-side, only from a trusted payment_attempt that has already reached SUCCESSFUL through the verified provider webhook flow (see the Payment collection). To exercise these endpoints: run the Checkout collection (Add Cart Item, Save Checkout Location, Create Appointment Hold), then the Payment collection's Create Payment. Against the local/testing fake gateway, completing the payment still requires a provider webhook delivery, which this collection deliberately does not attempt to simulate (see the Payment collection's own note on why POST /v1/payments/webhooks/stripe cannot be manually signed from Postman). Point this collection at a database row already advanced to SUCCESSFUL by the automated test suite, or by a real signed webhook delivery, to see a populated Booking.

Every response here is read-only and historical: it reflects exactly what was frozen into the Booking (and its Booking Items / Booking Location) at the moment of conversion, never the live catalog, live pricing, or the customer's current profile/cart.

request.description: Every Booking belonging to the authenticated customer, newest first. Ownership-scoped through booking -> cart -> customer_user_id - never reveals another customer's Bookings. Each entry is the same safe shape as Get Booking (status, currency, total, location snapshot, appointment snapshot, items with their frozen pricing) - never a live-repriced value.

Reads one Booking's full historical snapshot: uuid, booking_number, status, currency, total (derived from its Booking Items, never a live recalculation), location, appointment (slot + time window), and items (each with its own frozen service identity and pricing snapshot). Never returns payment_attempt_id, checkout_snapshot, checkout_snapshot_hash, idempotency_key, reconciliation fields, or any provider/Stripe data. Ownership-scoped through the booking's cart's customer_user_id - a foreign or unknown booking uuid returns 404, identically, whether it belongs to another customer or does not exist at all.
